'''Dashar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], she sold specialized gear for [[Sith Inquisitor]]s in the Combat Training section of [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dashar first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a level 50 Battlemaster PVP Gear vendor. She and all other Battlemaster gear vendors were removed from the game around Update 2.0 during an overhaul of the PvP gear system. She was later re-added in the game, but doesn't serve a function anymore.
